suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as post traumatic epilepsy risk. Require a documented traumatic skull fracture, including appropriately documented skull-vault or skull-base fracture, followed by separately diagnosed post-traumatic epilepsy. PMID 33687971 supports increased epilepsy risk after the coded skull-fracture phenotype in an adult hospitalized TBI cohort. Do not equate an acute provoked seizure during the index trauma admission with later epilepsy, and do not infer epilepsy from nonspecific head trauma without a qualifying skull fracture. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
